info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Warehouse Inventory Audits-v1-spec
info.description: The Warehouse Inventory Audit Listing API enables users to access comprehensive records of inventory audits conducted within the warehouse. This API allows stakeholders such as inventory managers and supply chain analysts to retrieve important details about audit activities, ensuring transparency and accountability. Key operations include fetching a list of audits, which helps in monitoring inventory accuracy and compliance. The API facilitates tracking discrepancies and validating inventory adjustments to optimize warehouse management practices.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the records of inventory audits, providing insights into stock levels and discrepancies over time. It is crucial for maintaining an accurate inventory system and ensuring accountability.
